title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-mp
content:
Meeting: Dedicated capacity weekly sync (prep notes)
Owner: Maya Patel (notes to self)
Date: 2026-03-03 weekly sync — agenda + action items

Context / purpose:
- Prep for weekly sync with SRE, sales ops, and product to align on GPU pool forecasts, reservation renewals, and autoscaling policy changes.
- Priority this quarter: reduce burst credit spend by 18% while keeping 99th percentile token latency SLAs.

Agenda (15-20m):
1) Quick metrics recap (2m)
   - Current committed capacity: 320 A100s equivalent across Dedicated customers (sum of reservations).
   - Active pools: 14 (region: us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1)
   - Avg util last 7d: 67% overall, 92% peak for seq-length>1024 workloads (late night spikes)
2) Forecast ask from sales ops (3m)
   - New committed deals likely: 40 A100-eq starting Apr 15 (+12%). Need decision for pre-buy or on-demand.
3) Autoscaling tuning proposal (7m)
   - Proposal: lower scale-down aggressiveness: min idle TTL = 10m -> 20m for chat workloads to reduce cold starts for short bursts.
   - Autoscale targets: scale up at 85% node util sustained 3m, scale down when below 55% for 20m.
   - Introduce burst-cap budget: allow per-customer 10% burst capacity for 30m/day (charges to be tracked).
4) Reservation renewals & pricing (3m)
   - Flag: two customers (ACME, BrightHealth) renewals due Mar 20. Confirm capacity mapping to pools.
5) Risks & mitigation (2m)
   - Kernel regressions on new quantized runtime (on staging). Fallback plan: route to CPU-quant or smaller model family.

Key numbers / short forecast (rolling 3-mo):
- Baseline committed (today): 320 A100-eq
- Expected signed by Apr 15: +40 A100-eq -> 360 A100-eq
- Upsell churn risk (probable): -8 A100-eq across two customers by May -> net 352 A100-eq
- Buffer target for SLA (10%): 35 A100-eq -> target pool capacity = ~387 A100-eq
- Current available burst capacity across pools: ~28 A100-eq (not reserved)

Questions I want answered in sync:
- Ops: how many hot nodes can we keep as warm-standby across us-west1 without incurring >$X/mo cost? (need concrete $ estimate)
- Billing: can we surface per-route burst consumption in console billing page by next month? (important for customers to self-manage)
- Sales ops: which deals are flexible on start date vs committed size? Any ask to pre-pay 6mo to secure discounts?

Notes / thoughts (rough):
- Tradeoff: longer min-idle TTL reduces cold starts but increases steady-state spend. Model: estimate +6% cost vs 30% reduction in cold start p95 latency for chat-heavy customers.
- Consider targeted TTL by profile: chat-heavy customers (ttl=20m), batch-heavy (ttl=5m). Need tagging/labeling of pools per-customer profile.
- If we add per-customer burst budgets, need enforcement at routing layer + billing signals. Might be 2-week delivery if infra + billing align.

Action items (owner, due):
- Maya: produce short runbook snippet for proposed autoscale params + expected cost delta (numbers by Wed 2026-03-04).
- Rajiv: estimate cost of keeping 10 hot standby A100-eq in us-west1 (runbook + exact $/mo) (due Fri 2026-03-06).
- Liam: quick check with sales ops on deal flexibility for ACME/BrightHealth (confirm start dates and pre-pay options) (due Thu 2026-03-05).
- Sofia: prototype console billing filter for burst-by-route (POC demo next Tues) (due 2026-03-10).
- Ops: add canary routing rule to fallback from quantized runtime to non-quantized model family if kernel regression detected (ticket JIRA-INF-2148) (owner: SRE oncall) (due ASAP).

Follow-up notes for meeting:
- If sales asks for pre-buy discount, we should push for 30-60 day notice and the option to convert to monthly commit.
- Prepare two commit scenarios for renewals: aggressive (assume full +40) vs conservative (+20) so we can show cost delta.

Notes-to-self (loose):
- Bring the pipeline latency histogram screenshot (last 48h) to meeting - shows nightly spike at 02:00 UTC for long-seq jobs.
- Remind SRE to correlate autoscale events with batch job scheduler (maybe batch tests are ramping during night).

References / links: 
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Dedicated+Capacity+Runbook
- Jira: JIRA-INF-2148 (autoscale fallback rule)
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/682 (hot-standby autoscale change)

Quick checklist before sync: 
[ ] attach latency histogram screenshot
[ ] confirm ACME renewals dates with sales
[ ] cost estimate stub from cloud billing (Rajiv)

End of prep notes.
summary: Weekly prep notes for dedicated capacity planning meeting: forecast +40 A100-eq, autoscale tuning proposal (scale-up 85% 3m, scale-down 55% 20m), buffer target ~10%, action items assigned to Maya, Rajiv, Liam, Sofia, ops.
